create_OneFormerProcessor: create a OneFormerProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for segmentation tasks
call_OneFormerProcessor: call OneFormerProcessor with images and task inputs to encode pixel values and task tokens for semantic instance or panoptic segmentation
encode_OneFormerProcessor_inputs: encode inputs with OneFormerProcessor by passing images task inputs and segmentation maps to produce model-ready tensors
post_process_OneFormer_semantic_segmenta: post process semantic segmentation output with OneFormerProcessor to convert model logits to pixel-wise class labels
post_process_OneFormer_panoptic_segmenta: post process panoptic segmentation output with OneFormerProcessor to combine semantic and instance predictions into panoptic results
